What changed vs. today, and why

  1. 1Static hero photo replaces the autoplay background video on phones — big win for load time and mobile data usage.
  2. 2Every primary button is 48–52px tall (was ~40px) to clear the iOS/Android minimum thumb tap-target size.
  3. 3Programs become a horizontal swipe carousel with a peeking edge, instead of three stacked full-width cards.
  4. 4A persistent two-button bottom action bar (Book · WhatsApp) replaces the single floating pill, padded for the home indicator / gesture bar.
  5. 5New quick-nav chip row under the hero lets visitors jump straight to Programs, Results, FAQ or Book instead of scrolling 8 sections.
